name: 01-first-poll-inserts-new-contacts
description: First run (no stored watermark) at 2015-10-10T10:00:10.123Z: the default watermark is now minus 10 s in UTC ISO format (2015-10-10T10:00:00.123Z). Both Salesforce contacts are new to the empty contact table, so both are INSERTed (first_name, last_name, email), and the watermark advances to the MAX LastModifiedDate. SalesforceToMySQLDBUsingBatchProcessingIT#testMainFlow expects a contact created in Salesforce to be present in the database.

source.reference: salesforce-to-MySQL-DB-using-Batch-Processing/src/main/app/salesforce-to-database.xml (flow triggerFlow: poll 60 s, watermark default-expression groovy now-10000 ms formatted yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z' UTC, selector=MAX selector-expression=#[payload.LastModifiedDate], sfdc:query 'SELECT Email,FirstName,LastModifiedDate,LastName FROM Contact WHERE LastModifiedDate > #[timestamp]'; batch:job salesforce-to-database-Batch: queryExistingContactInDbStep (dw mapping + db:select ... WHERE email=?), upsertContactInDbStep choice db:insert / db:update); src/main/resources/contact.sql
